paper.title: Fermionic Neural Network with Effective Core Potential
paper.authors: Xiang Li, Cunwei Fan, Weiluo Ren, Ji Chen

results.system_description: Ga atom, ccECP pseudopotential (3 valence electrons), clamped point nucleus, 2 up and 1 down electrons
results.source_location: Table II (label tab:ecp_energy_on_atoms), row Ga, column 'FermiNet + ECP' (main.tex line 398)
results.eligibility_evidence: The paper's own FermiNet + ECP energy from a separate inference phase (100,000 MCMC iterations, Table tab:exp_env), 'estimated via pure MCMC approach without training'; local-energy outlier removal was used only in training ('during inference phase we do not do such outlier removal').
results.notes: Valence-only ccECP instance (3 electrons, Ga core of 28 electrons removed); never compared with the all-electron Ga instance. Error bar not defined in the paper (recorded as unspecified). Nonlocal ECP term by 12-point icosahedral quadrature with one random orientation per sample (unbiased). Sector: see the instance (not printed; unique for the ground term).
